description: This file implements the GuestSession class for the Android confirmation UI HAL, handling user confirmation prompts, secure input events, and session lifecycle management within the confirmation UI framework.

classes.name: GuestSession
classes.description: Represents a guest session managing user confirmation prompts, secure input events, and session lifecycle within the Android confirmation UI framework.

methods.name: PromptUserConfirmation
methods.description: Handles the process of prompting the user for confirmation, managing different phases of the confirmation session, and returning the result.

methods.name: DeliverSecureInputEvent
methods.description: Simulates the delivery of a secure input event, primarily used for testing, and manages the session state accordingly.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts the current confirmation session, sending an abort command and pushing an abort message into the message queue.
